Rationale: The Candidate's query is structurally different from the Ground Truth LISP. The LISP describes a search for an entity of type <Issue> (the subject) that has a <Cancellation_date> of '2010-09-17' (the object). In contrast, the Candidate treats '2010-09-17' as the subject and asks for the <date> (the object) it was cancelled on. This represents a swap of the subject and object in the relationship, which falls under the 'Wrong relation' error category.
